notes_for_editor: Four sources agree the 1930 platform tower, 1932 L-4 cab and 1934 burning. The FFLA list gives the kind as 2-Story cab. These sources describe a 35-foot platform tower with a living-quarters cab on a log crib, so the record's two_story may fit the cab rather than the observation structure; left for the editor. The name-origin sentence comes from a place-name list in the Clearwater history; the entry does not give a location, so the link to this lookout is inferred from the name, and the story now says so. The Coeur d'Alene record (us-id-idaho-point) is a different tower with the same name: another forest, 6,505 feet, 14 miles ENE of Magee. No new photos found.
